help.title: Help & Support
help.faq1Q: How do I skip the queue?
help.faq1A: Place your order and pick a pickup slot in the app. Head straight to the counter at your slot time and show your pickup code — no need to line up.
help.faq2A: Yes, from the Orders tab you can cancel an active order before it's marked as ready. Refunds to your Campus Wallet are instant.
help.faq3Q: How does the Campus Wallet work?
help.faq3A: Top up your wallet from Payment Methods and use it at checkout for faster payment. Balance never expires and can be used at any campus counter.
help.faq4Q: What if an item is out of stock?
help.faq4A: We'll notify you immediately and offer a similar substitute or a full refund to your original payment method.
help.faq5Q: How do I earn loyalty points?
help.faq5A: You earn 10 points for every euro spent. Points can be redeemed for free items and discounts in the Rewards tab.
help.faq6Q: How do I update my dietary preferences?
help.faq6A: Go to Profile → Dietary Preference to set your primary diet and any allergies. This shapes your Home recommendations and flags allergens to the kitchen.

terms.title: Terms & Privacy
terms.questionsNote: Questions about these terms? Reach us at
terms.t1Body: CampusFlow lets verified students at partner universities pre-order meals from participating canteens and collect them at a scheduled pickup slot. You must be enrolled at a partner institution to place orders.
terms.t2Body: Orders are confirmed once payment is authorized via your Campus Wallet, saved card, or cash on pickup. Prices include applicable taxes. Canteens reserve the right to substitute unavailable items with a comparable alternative.
terms.t3Body: Orders can be cancelled free of charge before the canteen marks them as "preparing." Once preparation has started, cancellations are handled case-by-case by canteen staff.
terms.t4Body: Please collect your order within 15 minutes of your selected slot. Uncollected orders may be donated or discarded after this window in line with campus food-waste policy.
terms.t5Body: Points are earned on completed orders and have no cash value. CampusFlow may adjust the earning rate or reward catalog at any time with notice in-app.
terms.t6Body: Sharing pickup codes, reselling orders, or abusing promotional credit may result in a suspended account. We'll always try to reach out before taking action.
terms.p1Body: Your name, university email, order history, dietary preferences, and payment method labels (never full card numbers) — collected directly from you when you use the app.
terms.p2Body: To process orders, personalize meal recommendations, flag allergens to kitchen staff, and send order-status notifications. We never sell your data to third parties.
terms.p3Body: Dietary preferences and allergy notes are shared only with the preparing canteen for the specific order and are never used for advertising.
terms.p4Body: Order history is retained for 24 months for support and loyalty purposes. You can request full account deletion at any time from Help & Support.
terms.p5Body: You can access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time via Account Details, or by contacting privacy@campusflow.app.
